findings.message: "#ch-iris" has CSS `transform: scale(0)` and a GSAP tween animates scale. GSAP will overwrite the full CSS transform, discarding any translateX(-50%) centering or CSS scale value.
findings.fixHint: Remove `transform: scale(0)` from CSS and replace with GSAP properties: scale: 0. Example: tl.fromTo('#ch-iris', { scale: 0 }, { scale: 0, ...yourAnimation }). tl.fromTo is exempt from this rule.

findings.message: Initial hidden state for "#ck-pill" is set via tl.set(...) at position 0 inside the paused timeline. A zero-duration set at 0 does not render while the playhead sits exactly at 0, so frame 0 shows the un-hidden state.
findings.fixHint: Use gsap.set(...) (immediate, outside the timeline) for initial states, or author the hidden state directly in CSS/attributes.
